theme: So Be It (The Formal & Formulaic Subjunctive)
phoneme_focus: Bare base-form verbs in subjunctive; measured formal delivery of fixed expressions

grammar_point.title: The formal & formulaic subjunctive
grammar_point.en: Mandative subjunctive after verbs/adjectives of demand and fixed subjunctive expressions: I insist that he be present; It is essential that it remain; be that as it may; suffice it to say.
grammar_point.ar: صيغة الشرط الرسمية بعد أفعال/صفات الطلب، والعبارات الشرطية الثابتة: I insist that he be present؛ be that as it may؛ suffice it to say.

vocabulary.example: Be that as it may, we must decide today.
Suffice it to say, the outcome was poor.
If they refuse, so be it.
Far be it from me to object.
We will proceed, come what may.
I insist that he be informed.
They demand that she apologise.
The rules require that all attend.
We recommend that it be reviewed.
I propose that the vote be delayed.
It is essential that it remain confidential.
It is imperative that we act now.
It is vital that no one be excluded.
He spoke softly, lest he be overheard.
If I were you, I would wait.
God forbid it should fail.
Long live the republic.
He is, as it were, the architect of the plan.
The mandative subjunctive follows 'demand'.
The subjunctive sounds formal.
These are formulaic expressions.
The court decreed that he pay costs.
The contract stipulates that work begin at once.
Custom ordains that guests be greeted.
It is advisable that she be present.
It is crucial that records be kept.
A provision that fees be waived.
Formal decorum was observed.
A solemn declaration was made.
The clause is legally binding.
Henceforth, all requests be submitted in writing.

Saturday.prompt: Make five formal demands using the subjunctive ('I insist that he be…').

Sunday.prompt: State three requirements with 'It is essential/imperative/vital that…'.

Monday.prompt: Use 'be that as it may', 'suffice it to say', 'so be it' naturally.

Tuesday.prompt: Deliver a short formal statement using subjunctive and elevated diction.

Wednesday.prompt: Warn or caution using 'lest' and 'God forbid'.

Thursday.prompt: Role-play a formal committee decision using mandative structures.

Friday.prompt: Present a formal resolution (10-12 sentences) rich in subjunctive and fixed expressions.

writing_prompts: Write three 'It is essential/imperative/vital that…' statements.
Use 'be that as it may', 'suffice it to say', 'so be it' in context.
Draft a short formal resolution using the subjunctive throughout.
Rewrite three ordinary requests as formal subjunctive demands.
Write a formal declaration paragraph combining mandative and fixed subjunctive forms.
